newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT cash div for common, preferred shrs.
newsitem.headline: PLDT cash div for common, preferred shrs.

text.p: Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co Inc (PLDT) had declared a 1.60 peso cash dividend for its common shareholders and a 50 centavo cash dividend for its select preferred shareholders, the Philippine Stock Exchange said on Tuesday.
The record date for the 1.60 peso cash dividend had been set on June 16 with payment date on July 15.
The telephone company also said it would give a 50 centavo cash dividend to holders of its preferred shares series H, L and M as of June 26. The payment date was set on July 31.
